## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2019-07-22: S-1/A files form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.3 (85% sharing of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups on future Redemptions of LLC Units plus imputed interest)
- 2020-02-11: TRA executed at IPO close among OneWater Marine Inc., the TRA Holders (Legacy Owners of One Water Marine Holdings, LLC), the Goldman/Beekman Agent, and Jeffrey B. Lamkin as Agent for the other TRA Holders
- 2020-02-18: 8-K files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.1

## Explanation

OneWater Marine Inc. completed an Up-C IPO on February 11, 2020 and executed a Tax Receivable Agreement at closing obligating PubCo to pay 85% of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups attributable to future Redemptions of OneWater LLC Units, plus imputed interest, to the Legacy Owners through two Agents (the Goldman/Beekman Agent and Jeffrey B. Lamkin for the other TRA Holders). The contract has not been amended or terminated; unlike most peer firms, OneWater Marine has carried no valuation allowance because realization of the underlying DTAs is more-likely-than-not, and accordingly maintains a TRA liability of approximately $37.5M undiscounted at FY 2025 year-end (September 30, 2025). No cash payments under the TRA have been triggered to date. Credit-facility amendments include standard Permitted TRA Payments carve-outs but do not modify the contract; the 2022 Ocean Bio-Chem acquisition and 2026 divestiture did not affect the TRA. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
